name: context-slack
description: Slack delivery layer for context-kit: post a per-person 'who's got what' digest to a channel, and nudge whoever drains the pending queue — driven by the project's context.json (connections.slack, defaults.slackChannel, and the roster's slackMemberId), so one install serves every project. Nothing here posts unprompted. Requires the Slack connector and the context-kit plugin; the digest also reads Notion.
